The server reads no option 61 and handle keys every message type on extractMAC (pkt[28:28+hlen]). Overlay mutants on handler.go extractMAC, run under ./le job run: keying on xid reds TestRFC2131ChaddrContentsIdentifyTheClient and TestChaddrIdentifiesClientWithoutClientIdentifier; keying on all but the last chaddr octet reds TestRFC2131ChaddrContentsIdentifyTheClient.
